name: CollapseRowsToDelimitedNode
label: Collapse Rows to Delimited
description: Groups rows and concatenates the values of a target column into a single delimited string per group, producing one row per group.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: GroupByColumns
fields.label: Group By Columns
fields.description: Comma-separated columns that define the groups to collapse.

fields.name: TargetColumn
fields.label: Target Column
fields.description: The column whose values are concatenated within each group.

fields.name: Delimiter
fields.label: Delimiter
fields.description: The delimiter between concatenated values. Defaults to a comma.

fields.name: DistinctValuesOnly
fields.label: Distinct Values Only
fields.description: True to only include distinct values per group. Defaults to false.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the concatenated column. Defaults to '<TargetColumn>_Collapsed'.
